attention.title: The Prospector runner has been offline for 19 days
attention.why: connor-windows-runner-01 last heartbeat 2026-10-03 10:25 UTC. The cron created 20 campaigns (Murfreesboro and Smyrna, 10 trades) on Oct 13 and nothing has claimed them. The orchestrator now reports BACKLOG_FULL, so no new campaigns get created either. This is the mechanical reason prospecting stops.
attention.action: The code side is live. Add the TRENCHES_RUNNER_KEY repo secret in trenches-hq (same value as the worker RUNNER_API_KEY) and run the "Prospector runner" workflow once from the Actions tab. Until then nothing claims the 20 campaigns.

attention.title: Smartlead chosen for Trenches outreach; the campaign does not exist yet
attention.why: Decided 2026-10-22. The orchestrator is already wired to Smartlead but there is no campaign id in system_flags (SMARTLEAD_WEBSITE_CAMPAIGN_ID), so turning it on would enroll nobody. Qualified leads also still lack verified emails.
attention.action: Create the Trenches website-track campaign in Smartlead with the warmed sender, paste its id into system_flags as SMARTLEAD_WEBSITE_CAMPAIGN_ID, and add SMARTLEAD_API_KEY to the Claude environment. The partner will then hand you a lead list per day and the flag flip is one sentence from you.

attention.title: Three quotes sent 9 days ago, zero views
attention.why: Q-1004 Get Lit ($1,499 + $400/mo, sent Oct 12), Q-1005 Benson ($350 + $500/mo, Oct 13) and Q-1006 Benson ($650 + $250/mo, Oct 13). view_count is 0 on all three. Unviewed after a week usually means the email was missed, not declined.
attention.action: Call Patrick Benson and the Get Lit contact today. Tomorrow morning the partner will leave follow-up drafts in your Gmail Drafts in your voice; send the ones you like.

attention.title: Property manager campaign built Oct 13, never launched
attention.why: Recon found 29 verified PM and HOA firms and drafted a 3-email sequence. It is blocked on your mailing address, a subject line, and permission to create the Smartlead draft. Files are in OneDrive Clients/Trenches Group/Outreach/Property Managers Murfreesboro.
attention.action: Send the partner the mailing address line and the subject you want. It will build the Smartlead draft campaign, paused, for your one click.

attention.title: 19 qualified leads have a phone and nobody has called them
attention.why: Plumbers, HVAC, roofers and tree services around Murfreesboro, Smyrna, Columbia and Spring Hill, scored 65 to 80, no website or a broken one. Website-track email outreach requires a verified email, which none of them has, so they sit in QUALIFIED forever.
attention.action: Block 45 minutes and call the top 10. Ask the partner for the call sheet and a 20-second opener; it is in tomorrow's brief.

attention.title: Review queue is a research problem, not a scoring problem
attention.why: Requalification finished: 347 leads re-scored through the real workflow. 0 qualified, 5 disqualified (modern site), 342 back to review. The gap points land, but a 65 needs rating, reviews, a verified mobile or an email on record, and validation holds 236 for confidence, contradictions or missing listing evidence. Only re-enrichment supplies those.
attention.action: Start the runner (TRENCHES_RUNNER_KEY, then the Prospector runner workflow) so re-enrichment runs. Meanwhile the 86 priority-C leads with a verified gap and a phone are the call list; the morning brief carries the top 20.

attention.title: Two repos both claim to be the source of truth
attention.why: Trenches-Group (this review's repo) holds the recovered bundle and docs; trenches-hq holds the TypeScript source, agents, skills and client logs, and is what actually deploys. Trenches-Group has not been pushed since Oct 9. Keeping both means every fix has to land twice.
attention.action: Confirm: trenches-hq is the code; Trenches-Group keeps only docs/reviews and the dashboard. The partner will then stop syncing bundles into Trenches-Group.

attention.title: Smartlead API key is sitting in plaintext in a routine prompt
attention.why: The Vivid Outreach Reply Check prompt contains the full api_key. The Smartlead webhook secret is also plaintext in system_flags. House rule 13 says rotate on sight.
attention.action: Rotate the key in Smartlead, add it to the Claude environment as SMARTLEAD_API_KEY, and the partner will update the reply-check routine to read it from the environment.

attention.title: Stripe secret key was invalid on Oct 9; status unknown
attention.why: The _trenches log says prod STRIPE_SECRET_KEY was an mk_ key id, breaking checkout. No later entry says it was rotated.
attention.action: Confirm the rotation happened, then run docs/pricing-gate/smoke-live-stripe.mjs in trenches-hq.

attention.title: Orphaned pipeline state makes every dashboard lie
attention.why: Half done. 75 queued candidates on dead campaigns closed and 3 failed demo jobs cancelled on 2026-10-22. The session permission guard blocked the rest: 111 ACTIVE sequences and 255 pending steps, 256 FAILED campaigns to archive, 7 test reply drafts.
attention.action: From a desktop session or the Command Center: cancel the sequences with stop_reason ORPHANED_2026-09-13, archive the FAILED campaigns, cancel the test drafts. The SQL is in docs/reviews/2026-10-22-operating-review.md section 10.

attention.title: Two routines are stopping on purpose and telling you why
attention.why: Read their Oct 19 runs. Marketplace Monitor: "Claude in Chrome isn't available to this scheduled task because it runs in the cloud"; the tracker sheet has nothing after the Sep 26 baseline. Books refresh: "Stripe isn't authorized in this session", so it stopped before touching the books, as its runbook says.
attention.action: Open the Marketplace Monitor task in the desktop app and turn on "Require this computer". Reauthorize the Stripe connector at claude.ai/customize/connectors, then fire the books refresh by hand.

attention.title: Four security findings from Oct 1 are fixed and live
attention.why: PR #15 merged and both Workers deployed from GitHub Actions at 01:40 and 01:43 UTC. Live bundles verified.
attention.action: Nothing. Still open from Oct 1: webhook idempotency shared across three endpoints, and the quote view token doubling as a portal invite.

attention.title: Eight older Claude sessions are parked waiting on a one-line answer from you
attention.why: From the full session list (45 sessions back to Aug 30): Fenlo site polish (two unsourced stats; PRs 11 and 12 unmerged), Benson Q-1003 send decision, trenches-site dashboard settings for the Startup package session, the Laptop access runner question, Claude session review step 3 or 4, Benson social media package source, Command Center resurrection (Zapmail nameservers), customer portal build spec.
attention.action: Answer or archive them. Each one that stays open is a decision the partner cannot make for you.

Tap the phone number and a Request a site assessment button once on fenloservices.com from your phone. A few hours later, have the Fenlo site session star click_to_call and click_to_email under Admin, Data display, Events (property 555311551).
attention.title: Fenlo lead tracking is live; star the two events so the portal counts leads
attention.why: Phone and email taps on fenloservices.com now send click_to_call and click_to_email to Google Analytics (live since Oct 22). The portal Leads number only counts key events, and Google only lets you star an event after it has been seen once.
